purpose: Resources useful for comparison, methodology, or future tooling that are not part of the canonical 15-witness NINJAL Hentaigana DB corpus.
rules: Do not merge auxiliary witnesses into the canonical 15-witness distribution corpus.
Do not treat a same-work/same-edition-family copy as identical to a canonical witness unless copy-level identity is verified.
Machine-derived labels may guide candidate discovery but are not attestation authority by themselves.

sources.title: 伊勢物語
sources.repository: 国文学研究資料館 鉄心斎文庫 / CODH 日本古典籍データセット
sources.edition_subtype: 第二種本イ版（慶長13年再刊甲種本）
sources.relation_to_core_witness: Same work and same Saga-bon second-type family as core witness issg001, but a different holding/copy. Exact subtype/copy identity of issg001 is not yet verified.
intended_use: possible visual/context comparison after copy-level differences are controlled
prohibited_use: assuming glyph positions are identical to issg001

sources.title: Jibo-labeled classical hiragana image dataset
sources.method_note: Jibo labels were bootstrapped with a model trained using the NINJAL Hentaigana Jikei Database and then corrected by human inspection. The creators explicitly warn that mistakes may remain.
prohibited_use: treating machine-derived labels as primary attestation evidence
using unverified labels as human-confirmed examples
